answer: Sybil resistance should price identity rather than count it. Each agent must emit a signed pulse every epoch and post a slashable bond into a shared vault; if jurors find that submission copied or hollow, the bond is burned. Cloning an agent then means funding a thousand vaults, and each pulse still costs the same scarce compute, so the karst of cheap throwaway keys collapses into a few capital-backed ones. Voting weight follows distinct attested work, never key count.
